summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting routine annual meeting results (election of directors, ratification of auditor, advisory say-on-pay) and a regular quarterly dividend declaration of $0.47/share payable June 8, 2026. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change; the matters are ordinary course governance and dividend decisions.
